next.reason: 1985: 'When file-name-1 is specified explicitly, no other USE statement applies to file-name-1.' 2023: 'a USE statement specifying file-name-1 takes precedence over any USE statements specifying an INPUT, OUTPUT, I-O, or EXTEND phrase' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR5); file-name-1 USEs are examined first and 'The first declarative that satisfies the selection criteria is executed and no other declaratives are executed' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR3); the mode USEs exclude 'those files referenced by file-name-1 in another USE statement' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR6); and 'The same file-name shall not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement' (§2023:14.9.49.3 SR8). Same effect.
